args.requested_decision: Please arrange immediate on-station duty-of-care at MAN: issue meal/refreshment vouchers for all five passengers within S4.2 caps, provide clear guidance/wayfinding, and ensure assistance for P4 (WCHR) while they await re-routing/transport.
